title: Minimum Window Substring
stepTitle: Sliding Window & Two Pointer Combined Problems
intro: Two pointers / sliding window turn nested O(n²) scans into O(n) when the window/predicate is monotonic.
intuition: Move the pointer that improves the invariant (sum too big → shrink, etc.).
approach: Record answers when window is valid.

complexity.time: O(n) or O(n log n) if sort first

cpp.notes: Reuse this window idea for “Minimum Window Substring” with the right invariant.

python.code:
def two_sum_sorted(a, target):
    i, j = 0, len(a) - 1
    while i < j:
        s = a[i] + a[j]
        if s == target: return True
        if s < target: i += 1
        else: j -= 1
    return False
